newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Washington to withdraw one of its carriers in the Gulf; Iran conducts naval exercises amid American concern over the third submarine Iran is due to receive this year.

- Airlines increase number of flights to accommodate thousands of workers leaving due to new UAE immigration laws; exit permits issued for 40,000 Indians and extra flights start for 12,000 Bangladeshis.
- U.S. says Iraq crisis easing, Perry says Carl Vinson may be sent home.
- Bahrain says it is planning to lower budget deficit for 1997-98, plans to cut shortfall to 3.5 percent of GDP.
- UAE officials say new immigration law will be implemented rationally; most of the Sri Lankan maids working in UAE have left home.
